The path starts at (50.36,70.74), draws a line to (58.62,58.21), then an arc (A command) with radius 15.01, ending at (58.32,83.47), then a line back to the start point (50.36,70.74).  
The arc has a large-arc flag of 0 and sweep flag of 1, meaning it draws the smaller arc (less than 180°) between the two points.  
This creates a closed shape with two straight sides and one curved arc — a sector of a circle.  

Final answer: (I)
